notice.title: Instance notice
notice.intro: One short message under the header of every signed-in page, such as a maintenance window or “this is a demo”. Write a link inside the sentence as [words](address). It is your own text, so it isn’t translated.
notice.messageHint: Plain text on one line. Link with [words](address): https:// or a single / for a page on this site, up to {links, number} links. {used, number} of {max, number} characters.
notice.toneHint: Warning is for something that needs care, such as data being reset.
notice.shownHint: Turning it off keeps the text, so you can turn it on again.
notice.previewEmpty: Write a message to see it here.
notice.previewHidden: Hidden: nobody sees it until you show it.

errors.message_empty: Write the message before showing the notice.
errors.message_too_long: Use up to {max, number} characters, on one line.
errors.link_label: A link needs its words, up to {label, number} characters: [words](address).
errors.link_address: Use an address that starts with https:// or a single /, with no spaces: [words](address).
errors.too_many_links: Use at most {links, number} links in the message.

passwordChange.checkbox: Ask them to choose a new password when they sign in
passwordChange.checkboxHint: Only they will know it. Accounts that sign in with a provider aren’t affected.
passwordChange.clearTitle: Stop asking for a new password
passwordChange.askBody: At their next sign-in they must choose their own password before anything else. Their password, sessions and tokens stay as they are.
passwordChange.clearBody: They will no longer be asked to choose a new password. Their password, sessions and tokens stay as they are.
passwordChange.askedDone: They will be asked to choose a new password at their next sign-in.
passwordChange.clearedDone: They will no longer be asked to choose a new password.

users.title: Users
users.description: Who can use this instance. Only root creates users; nobody signs up.

create.title: Create user
create.name: Name
create.rootBody: Manage users (other roots included), scopes, settings and the audit log, and approve their own submissions.

oneTime.title: Shown once
oneTime.body: Give this to the user through a trusted channel. It won’t be shown again.
